name: rushd
description: Arabic-first personal finance assistant for tracking expenses, budgets, goals, and spending insights.

scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.js tailwind.config.cjs postcss.config.cjs vite.config.mjs scripts/visual-parity.cjs scripts/browser-smoke.cjs scripts/smoke-check.mjs scripts/font-license-guard.mjs tests/font-license-guard.test.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/smoke-check.mjs && node tests/font-license-guard.test.mjs && node scripts/finance-rules.test.mjs && node scripts/p00-fixtures.test.mjs && node scripts/p00-characterization.test.mjs && node tests/p01-dangerous-mutations.test.mjs && node tests/p01-stability.test.mjs && node scripts/p00-artifact-guards.test.mjs && node scripts/verify-p00-baseline.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 RUSHD_SMOKE_ROOT=dist node scripts/browser-smoke.cjs
scripts.parity:quick: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 node scripts/visual-parity.cjs --profile quick --candidate dist
scripts.parity:full: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 node scripts/visual-parity.cjs --profile full --candidate dist
scripts.parity:self-test: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 node scripts/visual-parity.cjs --self-test --candidate dist
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:browser && npm run parity:self-test && npm run parity:quick
